rationale: The short thesis is working and mechanically intact: price sits below session VWAP ($54.10) and the 9-EMA ($53.54), is consolidating on declining volume just 1.2% off the lows after a failed gap-up on 5x relative volume, and the tape is risk-off (SPY -0.27%, VIXY +1.19%). The trade shows favorable asymmetry so far (+0.84% gain, max adverse excursion only -0.31%) with the $52.30 target still offering ~1.7% of runway if $52.60 breaks. Flipping long would mean fighting the dominant intraday trend and re-crossing a wide ~36 bps spread, while closing forfeits a live edge for no reason.
